text:
Mia Chen: quick heads-up — q4b-int4 bringup shows a recall drop on long-context codegen prompts vs fp16 baseline. failing cases concentrated on prompts >1200 tokens. can we spin a small golden refresh and a labeler batch to sanity-check?
Olivia Park: ugh, saw the perf graphs earlier. is this from the nightly quant evaluation or the new ingest?
Mia Chen: nightly quant eval (run id: qbrun-2026-03-22-14). attached sample failure IDs below.
Mia Chen: ```
failures: ["smp-84321", "smp-84322", "smp-84347"]
metric: recall@5 dropped from 0.93 -> 0.78 on longctx subset
model: q4b-int4-v2
```
Raj Patel: thanks. I can run a focused rerun with KV-cache warmup toggled off to rule out cache priming. planning to run in the next 30m.
Samir (labeler): FYI labelers can take a microbatch for this. what labeling rubric do you want? binary accept/reject for correct code output?
Mia Chen: yes — binary plus a short note if partially correct (e.g., missing edge-case or truncated answer). target batch size 40, expected turnaround 48h. mark high-priority.
Olivia Park: @Samir (labeler) can you carve out 1 engineer-labeler pair to do quick-scan? we only need 40 longform examples + 20 control short prompts.
Samir (labeler): can do. I'll create a batch with tags: longctx-quickscan, q4b-int4-regress. starting with high-confidence failures first. ETA to assign: 1h.
labeler-bot: created batch 7893 (longctx-quickscan) with 60 units. reviewers: @Samir (labeler), @Olivia Park. deadline: 48h.
Raj Patel: rerun kicked off: `./scripts/eval_quant.sh --model q4b-int4-v2 --subset longctx --kv-warmup off`. will paste logs when done.
deploy-bot: nightly-eval job qbrun-2026-03-22-14 finished with status FAILED on subset longctx. see /evals/qbrun-2026-03-22-14/logs
Olivia Park: also thinking we should lock this model from auto-rollout until we confirm. can product/routing set a hold?
Mia Chen: agreed — toggled auto-rollout off for q4b-int4-v2 in the catalog. noted in the rollback policy.
Samir (labeler): small question on labeling: for truncated outputs should we mark reject if missing final line?
Mia Chen: yes — reject if missing the final code block or fail to compile when expected. add comment with the failing token index if obvious.
Raj Patel: rerun logs: `peak_seq=2048, avg_latency +4ms, recall@5=0.80 (post-kv-off)`. improvement but still below baseline. saving full diffs to /artifacts/q4b-int4-v2/diffs.gz
Olivia Park: ok. once label batch completes we'll run the microgolden (10 examples) for A/B and then decide quantization profile tweaks (per-layer scale or remap).
Mia Chen: thanks team. tracking: batch 7893 assigned, rerun in progress, auto-rollout disabled. I'll open a tiny GH issue with links and assign to @Raj and @Olivia. :thumbsup:
Olivia Park: thanks — ping me if labelers hit ambiguous cases, we can escalate to 2nd reviewer.
Samir (labeler): noted, starting assignment now.
Mia Chen: end of thread — will post summary after labels in 48h.
